layout_summary: An asymmetric parody poster layout on a pure white canvas, pairing a red stiletto heel whose pitchfork tip dips into an open spread jar on the left with a stacked serif title lockup on the right. A single-line bold red tagline spans the full width across the bottom margin to anchor the composition.

scene.subject: A glossy crimson high-heeled pump angled upward from the left edge, its stiletto heel morphing into a three-pronged red pitchfork dipping into an open glass jar overflowing with smooth caramel-brown biscuit spread, with a thick drip running down the right side of the jar onto the surface.
scene.composition: Positioned in the left third of the canvas; the back of the shoe crops off the left edge between y=41.0% and y=52.5%, while the jar sits grounded near the lower left (x=14.5%–35.0%, y=55.5%–82.5%) casting a soft shadow to its left.
scene.camera: Eye-level studio product shot with a normal-to-short-telephoto lens feel and deep focus keeping both shoe and jar crisp.
scene.lighting: Bright, soft studio lighting from the upper right, creating sharp specular white highlights along the red patent leather shoe and glossy spread, and a soft diffused contact shadow falling to the bottom-left of the jar.

elements.text: Don't be silly Andrea, everybody wants this.

ornaments.description: Elongated right arm of the letter 'V' in 'DEVIL' extending upward and terminating in a pointed black devil-tail arrowhead

why_it_works: Instant cultural recognition: replicates the iconic movie-poster typography, red-and-black palette, and white negative space while seamlessly swapping the stiletto heel into a pitchfork dipping into the product.
Strong left-to-right visual balance: the tall, high-contrast red shoe and overflowing jar on the left counterweight the stacked serif title lockup on the right without cluttering the white ground.
Clear typographic contrast: pairing classic editorial serifs for the parody title with a friendly rounded brand sans-serif for the bottom quote separates the joke from the brand voice.
